{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background and expose a login prompt reachable at telnet 127.0.0.1 6665, then block until readiness is confirmed.","required_artifacts":["A running QEMU process using /app/alpine.iso","A launch log or receipt showing the VM was started with host port 6665 forwarded to guest telnet/serial login access"],"required_behaviors":["QEMU remains running in the background after launch","Connecting to 127.0.0.1:6665 shows a login prompt","The prompt is observed before finalization"],"known_invalid_patterns":["Only verifying file existence","Only verifying QEMU binary availability","Only verifying that port 6665 is open without a login prompt","Launching QEMU in the foreground so the agent does not leave it running"],"verification_plan":["Inspect workspace for any helper scripts or prior receipts","Launch QEMU detached/backgrounded with port forwarding to 6665","Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed"],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt-backed launch command for QEMU","Receipt-backed probe output showing the login prompt on 127.0.0.1:6665"],"notes":["Preserve the original request if derived state conflicts with it."]},{"type":"working_checklist","items":["Inspect workspace contents and any prior receipts","Determine the correct QEMU invocation for Alpine ISO boot and telnet access","Start QEMU in the background with host port 6665 exposed","Probe localhost:6665 until the login prompt appears","Keep the VM running after readiness is confirmed"]},{"type":"raw_bash","command":"cd /app && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort","timeout_seconds":30}]}
